text: Running original build of fixture-calc (fixtures/app1), served locally as the Tier A oracle. The Medium does not see its source.

source: fixtures/app1 README (written today for lane testing)
text: fixture-calc is a four-function pocket calculator. The display starts at 0. Typing digits appends them, and a leading 0 is replaced. Supports +, x and / with an = key. Results are truncated to two decimals. C clears everything back to 0.

source: fixture issue #1 (written today for lane testing)
text: Dividing by zero shows Error on the display instead of a number.

source: fixture issue #2 (written today for lane testing)
text: Pressing an operator twice in a row, like 7 + + 8 =, seems to use the second press only. Not sure, could not reproduce every time.
